journey.name: Checkout one item
journey.description: A user can complete checkout for a single item.

actions.action: Tap "Hamburger" menu
Tap "Log In" menu
Type "standard_user" in the Username field
Type "secret_sauce" in the Password field
Tap the "LOGIN" button
Verify that the "PRODUCTS" screen is shown with at least one product listed
Tap the "Sauce Labs Backpack" product to open its details
Tap the "Add to cart" button
Tap the "View cart" cart icon at the top of the screen
Tap the "Proceed To Checkout" button. This should open the shipping address form
Type "Dika" in the Full Name field
Type "Jalan Sudirman 1" in the Address Line 1 field
Type "Jakarta" in the City field
Type "12345" in the Zip Code field
Type "Indonesia" in the Country field
Tap the "To Payment" button. This should open the payment method form
Type "Dika" in the Full Name field
Type "4111111111111111" in the Card Number field
Type "0328" in the Expiration Date field
Type "123" in the Security Code field
Tap the "Review Order" button. This should open the order review screen
Verify that "Sauce Labs Backpack" and a total price are shown on the overview
Tap the "Place Order" button
Verify that an order confirmation / thank-you message is shown
